text: The power to change tomorrow begins with the courage to live today.
author: Albert Camus

text: The darkest moments often prepare the brightest light.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: When the heart moves, the path always opens.
author: Hermann Hesse

text: Life begins anew the moment you decide to love yourself.
author: Virginia Woolf

text: Hope is the strongest force we can create within ourselves.
author: Helen Keller

text: Even the smallest flutter of wings can create a great wind.
author: Haruki Murakami

text: If you fall today, it only means you’re ready to rise stronger tomorrow.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: Happiness isn’t grand; it’s the simple act of loving this very moment.
author: Beopjeong Sunim

text: Even moments of trembling become seeds of growth.
author: Kim Soo-young

text: Life goes on, and therefore, it can become beautiful again.
author: Susan Sontag
